تفترضي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِضِي (taftariḍī) /taf.ta.ri.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# تُفْتَرَضِي (tuftaraḍī) /tuf.ta.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
